title: Income Tax Department Kolkata Recruitment 2026 – Tax Assistant (TA), Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) Posts
shortInfo: Income Tax Department Kolkata has announced notification for Tax Assistant (TA), Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) posts. Required qualification: Degree, Matriculation. Last date to apply: 30-09-26.

dates.event: Last Date of Submission of Application

howToApply: Download and fill the application form in the prescribed format as given in ANNEXURE-A in black or blue dot ink in Capital Letters only.

Attach attested photocopies (by a Gazetted Officer) of all required documents: Photo Identity Proof, Address Proof, Birth Certificate, Mark sheets & Certificates of Class 10, 12, Graduation, Caste Certificate, PwBD Certificate (if applicable), and Certificates of Sports achievements.
Attach Sports achievements certified by recognized authorities in specified Forms (as per ANNEXURE-D).
Attach Declaration (ANNEXURE-B) and Certificates (ANNEXURE-C) if applicable.
Write on the envelope: “APPLICATION FOR THE POST(S) OF ________ FOR RECRUITMENT OF MERITORIOUS SPORTS PERSONS IN INCOME TAX DEPARTMENT, WEST BENGAL & SIKKIM”.

Send the application by Normal Post / Speed Post / Registered Post / Courier to: Joint Commissioner of Income Tax, Headquarters (Personnel & Establishment), Kolkata, 1st Floor, Room No-14, Aayakar Bhawan, P-7 Chowringhee Square, Kolkata- 700069.
Additionally, fill in the Google Form at https://forms.gle/sf7iXVo1WeosAjtV6 with essential particulars.
Application must reach the office on or before 30.09.2026.

title: Bank of Baroda (BOB) Recruitment 2026 – Local Bank Officer LBO (Last Date Extended) Posts
shortInfo: Bank of Baroda (BOB) has announced notification for Local Bank Officer LBO (Last Date Extended) posts. Required qualification: Graduation in any discipline, 1 year experience. Last date to apply: 17-09-26.

fees.fee: Rs. 850/- (Inclusive of GST) + Payment Gateway Charges

fees.category: SC / ST / PwBD / Ex-Servicemen (ESM/DESM) / Women candidates
fees.fee: Rs. 175/- (Inclusive of GST) + Payment Gateway Charges

dates.event: Last Date for Submission of Application & Payment of Fees (Extended Upto)

howToApply: Visit Bank’s official website www.bankofbaroda.bank.in under Career section → Current Opportunities.
Register online in the appropriate Online Application Format available through the link on the Careers → Current Opportunities page.
Upload scanned photograph, signature, bio-data, and other required documents as per specifications.
Carefully fill in all details in the online application form. No changes are permitted after clicking SUBMIT.
Pay the application fee online using Debit Card / Credit Card / Internet Banking / UPI etc.
On successful payment, an e-receipt and application form will be generated — print and retain for future reference.
Note down the acknowledgement number and keep a copy of the application form for future reference.
Download call letters from the Bank’s website under Career section → Current Opportunities using registration details and password.

title: AAI Recruitment 2026 – Graduate Apprentice, Diploma Apprentice, ITI Apprentice Posts
shortInfo: AAI has announced notification for Graduate Apprentice, Diploma Apprentice, ITI Apprentice posts. Required qualification: Graduate Degree / Diploma / ITI. Last date to apply: Update.
howToApply: Graduate/Diploma candidates must register on the NATS portal: https://nats.education.gov.in
ITI candidates must register on the NAPS portal: https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
After registration, search for the concerned AAI Establishment ID corresponding to your preferred location.
Submit the online application through the respective portal.
Applications submitted through any other mode shall not be accepted.
